fact: RSTP's National Data Centre was operating as of 2026-09-24 and RSTP said it provides IT solutions to both public and private sectors, as reported by the Times of Eswatini; it was hit by an incident disrupting at least 12 government services.
RSTP's National Data Centre offers colocation (rack space, power, connectivity), dedicated servers and cloud services to clients, per its own brochure; undated, the published date 2023-07 is used.

The operator's brochure describes the National Data Centre as a Tier-III energy-efficient facility with 99.982% uptime (operator's statement, no certification named); undated, the published date 2023-07 is used.
RSTP's operator page describes the National Data Centre as offering colocation, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and remote hands, with carrier-neutral connectivity; undated, the published date 2021 is used.

fact: ICT Minister Savannah Maziya said banks and telecoms have chosen not to use the Royal Science and Technology Park's data centre, and that the park earns money by storing data; Tier III is a long-term goal, not stated as reached.
